limitations: All tabs share the current login and tenant/organization; no independent-tab organization or BFF/HttpOnly redesign is introduced.
Browser API/Socket.IO behavior uses controlled fixtures. No new real backend/database refresh consumption, production deployment or external publication is claimed.
A sent one-time operation with an uncertain result quarantines its record; reauthentication recovers it without replaying the old refresh or context operation.
Old host bundles must be closed/reloaded when adopting this coordinator; rollback to a pre-coordinator host requires reauthentication, not credential dual-writing.
Web Locks or usable persistent storage missing means explicit unsupported UI. Missing BroadcastChannel uses the verified storage-event and resume-read path.
Chrome/Edge two stable majors are bound to the actual listed official versions. Firefox/Safari and future versions are not claimed.
Phase11 and later phases, immutable SDK/wire changes, backend/DB migrations, old scratch deletion and production operations remain outside this execution.
